tieu_de: Hardware Engineer Hardware Design, ARM, Embedded
dia_chi_raw: Tầng 8, toà nhà BCONS TOWER, số 176/1-176/3 Nguyễn Văn Thương
mo_ta_cong_viec:
IriTech Incorporation is the global leader in iris recognition technology, delivering advanced biometric solutions including high-performance iris cameras, portable authentication devices, OEM modules, and iris recognition software for governments, enterprises, and emerging applications in mobile, automotive, AR/VR, and more.
To support our innovative hardware development and integration of iris biometrics into diverse embedded platforms, we are seeking a talented Hardware Engineer to join our engineering team.
In this role, you will design, develop, test, and optimize electronic hardware and PCB architectures for IriTech's iris recognition hardware and embedded devices, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performance operation across commercial and enterprise platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Participate in design, schematic capture, and PCB layout for iris biometric devices, including portable scanners, enrollment cameras, and OEM modules.
Select, evaluate, and integrate hardware components, including image sensors, IR LEDs, power management ICs, microcontrollers, and SoCs.
Implement hardware architectures supporting low-level peripherals, power management, and interfaces such as USB, GPIO, I2C, and SPI.
Perform board bring-up, hardware verification, signal integrity analysis, and functional debugging on target hardware platforms.
Conduct compliance and pre-certification testing (EMI/EMC, CE, FCC, RoHS) for biometric hardware products.
Collaborate with mechanical, firmware, software, and product teams to deliver robust hardware for government projects (e.g., national ID programs) and commercial biometric solutions.
Work with PCB fabrication and assembly (PCBA) partners for prototyping, Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and mass production.
Document hardware architecture, schematics, Bill of Materials (BOM), and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university.
3+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware design and PCB layout (fresh graduates with strong relevant projects and skills will be considered).
Proficiency in EDA/CAD software for schematic capture and multi-layer PCB design (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD, PADS, or KiCAD).
Strong understanding of embedded hardware architectures (ARM preferred), high-speed digital circuit design, power management, and analog/digital peripherals (USB, GPIO, I2C, SPI).
Hands-on experience with lab measurement equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, multimeters).
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with hardware schematics, datasheets, and layout constraints.
Good English communication skills (written and spoken).
Team-oriented mindset: diligent, reliable, dynamic, and collaborative.
